steps.title: Prepare input CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a .csv file with headers as shown in the example, include the columns ‘Source Labware’, ‘Source Well’, ‘Dest Labware’, ‘Dest Well’, and any other required fields, using the Opentrons Labware Library API names for labware; then upload this file to the protocol.

steps.title: Select pipette and mount
steps.instruction: Choose the pipette model you will use (single‑channel) and specify whether it is mounted on the left or right side of the robot.

steps.title: Choose tip type and usage
steps.instruction: Specify the tip type (e.g., filter tips) and decide on a tip usage strategy: either a new tip for each transfer or reusing the same tip throughout the protocol.

steps.title: Transfer liquids according to CSV
steps.instruction: For each row in the uploaded CSV, perform the following actions:

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the user‑specified volume from the source labware and well at the slot indicated in the CSV, using the designated aspiration height measured from the bottom of the well.
Dispense the same volume into the destination labware and well at the slot indicated in the CSV.

steps.title: Repeat for all rows
steps.instruction: Continue the aspirate‑and‑dispense sequence for every entry in the CSV until the file is exhausted.
